data.name: DataView_AddAMosquittoBroker
data.value: Add a Mosquitto broker to the brokers' compose file

data.name: DataView_EachBrokerRunsAsAContainer
data.value: Each broker runs as a container. Their compose project is also on Dev Tools / Containers, with its logs and command output.

data.name: DataView_MakeAServerCertificateOnCertificates
data.value: For TLS, make a server certificate on Dev Tools / Certificates first.

data.name: DataView_NoBrokersYet
data.value: No brokers yet. Add one, then press Start.

data.name: DataView_NoDatabasesYet
data.value: No databases yet. Add one, then press Start.

data.name: DataView_OnTheMutualTlsPort
data.value: On the mutual TLS port, clients must show a certificate signed by this CA

data.name: DataView_RemoveTheBrokerItsContainer
data.value: Remove the broker. Its container is stopped and removed first.

data.name: DataView_SaveTheBrokerAndWriteIt
data.value: Save the broker and write its files. A running broker is started again with the change.

data.name: DataView_StartThisBroker
data.value: compose up -d for this broker: write its files, build its image and start it

data.name: DataView_StopTheCommand
data.value: Stop the command. Containers it already changed stay as they are.

data.name: DataView_StopThisBroker
data.value: compose stop for this broker: stop its container and keep it

data.name: DataView_TheStateOfItsMqttClient
data.value: The state of its client on Dev Tools / Brokers / MQTT

data.name: DataView_WhatTheBrokerShowsOnItsTlsPorts
data.value: What the broker shows to clients on its TLS ports, from Dev Tools / Certificates

data.name: DataView_EachDatabaseRunsAsAContainer
data.value: Each database runs as a container, with its data in a folder on this computer, so the data stays when the container is removed. Their compose project is also on Dev Tools / Containers, with its logs and command output.

data.name: DataView_AddAPostgresDatabase
data.value: Add a PostgreSQL database to the databases' compose file

data.name: DataView_HowToConnect
data.value: How to connect from this computer. The password is the one you gave.

data.name: DataView_StartThisDatabase
data.value: compose up -d for this database: write its files, make its data folder and start it

data.name: DataView_StopThisDatabase
data.value: compose stop for this database: stop its container and keep it

data.name: DataView_RemoveTheDatabaseItsContainer
data.value: Remove the database. Its container is stopped and removed first; its data folder is kept.

data.name: DataView_WhereTheDatabaseKeepsItsFiles
data.value: The folder on this computer that holds the database's files

data.name: DataView_TheFolderMustBeSharedWithTheEngine
data.value: Made when the database is saved. With Podman or Docker Desktop, the folder must be one the engine's virtual machine shares, such as one in your home folder. Changing it later does not move the data.

data.name: DataView_SaveTheDatabaseAndWriteIt
data.value: Save the database and write its files. A running database is started again with the change.

data.name: DatabaseBrowser_NoPasswordIsSaved
data.value: No password is saved for {0}. Edit it and give one.

data.name: DatabaseBrowser_TheRowHadAlreadyChanged
data.value: The row had already changed or gone, so nothing was deleted. The rows are read again.

data.name: DataView_Browse_Subtitle
data.value: Choose one of the databases above while it runs to see its schemas, tables, columns and first rows. Add and drop schemas, tables and columns, and insert, edit and delete rows. Each change is made in the database at once.

data.name: DataView_Browse_ReadAgain
data.value: Read the schemas, tables and rows again

data.name: DataView_Browse_WithAnIdColumnTip
data.value: Starts the table with id bigint, numbered for each row, as its primary key

data.name: DataView_Browse_ColumnDefaultTip
data.value: An SQL expression, such as now() or 'none' with its quotes. Empty for none.

data.name: DataView_Browse_AddColumnTip
data.value: ALTER TABLE … ADD COLUMN with this name, type and default

data.name: DataView_Browse_DeleteTip
data.value: Delete this row from the table

data.name: DataView_Browse_InsertHint
data.value: Values are read as the column's type, as PostgreSQL reads text. Leave a box empty for the column's default, or switch on NULL.

data.name: DataView_Browse_PickATable
data.value: Choose or create a table to see its columns and rows.

data.name: DataView_Browse_EditTip
data.value: Put this row's values in the form below, to change and save

data.name: DataView_Browse_EditHint
data.value: Change the values and press Save. Only the columns you change are saved; switch on NULL for no value.

data.name: DataView_Browse_SaveRowTip
data.value: UPDATE the row with the columns changed

data.name: DatabaseBrowser_TheRowHadAlreadyChangedSoNotSaved
data.value: The row had already changed or gone, so nothing was saved. The rows are read again.

data.name: DataView_Browse_NoColumns
data.value: No columns yet. Add one below.

data.name: DataView_Browse_DropSchemaTip
data.value: Drop the schema chosen, with every table in it. Asks first.

data.name: DataView_Browse_DropTableTip
data.value: Drop the table chosen, with its rows. Asks first.

data.name: DataView_Browse_DropColumnTip
data.value: Drop this column, with its values. Asks first.

data.name: DatabaseBrowser_DropTheSchema
data.value: Drop the schema {0}, with every table and row in it, and anything elsewhere that depends on them? This cannot be undone.

data.name: DatabaseBrowser_DropTheTable
data.value: Drop the table {0}.{1}, with all its rows, and the views and keys that depend on it? This cannot be undone.

data.name: DatabaseBrowser_DropTheColumn
data.value: Drop the column {0} of {1}.{2}, with its values, and the views and keys that depend on it? This cannot be undone.

data.name: DataView_Browse_ResizeTip
data.value: Drag to make the column wider or narrower. Double-click to fit it to its values.
